figure.purpose: Counts and stats in tabular numerals.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action on an area.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{background:#e6e8ee;color:#0d0e12;border:1px solid #e6e8ee;border-radius:6px;min-height:36px;padding:7px 14px;font:600 15px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:#fff}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:scale(.97)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #d9a441;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Chip
components.description: Toggle swatch with a drawn state square.

components.name: Station
components.description: One stop on the signal path.
components.css: .ds-station{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:12px 16px;background:#1a1d24;color:#ececf1;font:400 13px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-station strong{font:600 15px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-station p{margin:0;color:#b6bac6}.ds-num{width:22px;height:22px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:4px;background:#d9a441;color:#17120a;font:600 13px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif}

narrative.overview: A stage manager's paperwork for a show with three audiences, printed in the dark. Near-black surfaces, visible hairlines, one quiet tungsten accent used small.
keyCharacteristics: Every state has a shape and a word
Long areas split into in-page tabs
The signal path is the signature element

rules.name: The Small Accent Rule
rules.body: Tungsten never fills a large area and is never a translucent tint.

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: State is a shape plus a word.

rules.name: The Lit-Edge Rule
rules.body: Raised things get a light top edge and an offset shadow; sunken things get an inner shadow.

dos: Do pair every state colour with a shape and a word.
Do put long settings behind in-page tabs or a disclosure.
Do keep destructive controls outline-only and isolated.
donts: Don't add html backgrounds, color-scheme or global element styles to the shared stylesheet.
Don't use gradients, glows, blur or coloured side stripes, or amber at low opacity over a dark surface.
Don't introduce a second accent colour or a saturated field.
